title: Workshop Relay
flavor_text: No station can begin until its incoming crates arrive.
content: Station A yields 13, Station B yields 15. Feed A then B into Station C to obtain letters M and O. Independent stations yield S and A; the final station combines an index 9 with a cipher result 3. Follow the dependency order and concatenate the six outputs.
notes: Synthetic heterogeneous subtask DAG with explicit dependencies.
